decision: The docs do not say what happens to a slot when a customer cancels within 24 hours of it, so the Human must choose.

decision_options.summary: The slot goes back on the calendar at once.
decision_options.tradeoffs: A walk-in can take it, and a customer who changes their mind may lose it.

decision_options.summary: The slot stays held until the front desk releases it.
decision_options.tradeoffs: The desk keeps control, and adds a step to a busy counter.
